english.title: Use a motor cycle on a road fitted with an exhaust system / silencer which did not comply with the regulation
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[motor bicycle,]_
(B)_[moped,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), fitted with

(C)_[an exhaust system]_

english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 57A(13) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
